name: Antigravity CLI (RHEL)
description: Installs Google's Antigravity CLI (agy), verified against its release checksum.

agentVersion.description: Antigravity CLI build to install. Leave empty to install the newest release; the build log names it as <version>-<build> (e.g. 1.5.9-4515810895593472), and setting that value pins that exact build. A bare version (e.g. 1.5.9) is only accepted while it is still the newest release. agy updates itself in the background whenever its install directory is writable by the user.
